title: Nigerian business-day arithmetic with observed holidays
why_it_matters: Delivery dates, loan due dates and SLA clocks depend on business days. Off-by-one errors from timezone or DST handling, and holidays that fall on weekends, produce wrong promises to customers.
expected_failure_mode: Models use local-time Date arithmetic (breaks across DST) or mishandle weekend holidays that collide with each other or with a weekday holiday.
